description: RevenueDot App Monetization: plugin and skills for Claude, Codex and Cursor that plan, price, build and test an app's subscriptions and paywall, add them with RevenueDot, migrate from RevenueCat and self-host RevenueDot, the open-source RevenueCat alternative.
rules: Install in Claude Code with `/plugin marketplace add revenuedot/agent-skills`, then `/plugin install revenuedot@revenuedot`; for skills only, run `npx skills add revenuedot/agent-skills`.

Use plan-monetization, price-and-package, store-setup-apple, store-setup-google, wire-subscription-sdk, paywall-design, entitlements-and-server and sandbox-testing for monetization work without an account; the free knowledge server is https://mcp.revenuedot.app/kit/mcp.
Use add-subscriptions to add a paywall and subscriptions to an iOS, Android, React Native or Flutter app, and migrate-from-revenuecat to move an existing RevenueCat app without losing a subscriber.

The plugin connects to the RevenueDot MCP server at https://mcp.revenuedot.app/mcp; the Claude connector uses https://mcp.revenuedot.app/claude/mcp and the ChatGPT plugin https://mcp.revenuedot.app/chatgpt/mcp.
Apps keep the RevenueCat SDK and set its proxy URL to https://api.revenuedot.app (RevenueDot Cloud) or to their own RevenueDot server.
